assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production PNG background for a children's learning reports journal, blank reusable UI asset. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCE only. Create the empty landscape journal board seen in the central area of the reference, closely matching its warm honey-brown polished carved wooden rim, fine wood grain, gently rounded rectangular corners, cream ivory lightly mottled parchment center, subtle golden inner bevel, small bronze binder pins vertically spaced along the left edge, small clusters of glossy jungle leaves ONLY over top-left and bottom-right corners. Front-on orthographic view, landscape approximately 1.69:1. The entire board should nearly fill the canvas with a very narrow transparent margin, intact edges and corner leaves. Center is completely blank uninterrupted parchment, no writing, no lines, no headings, no characters, no buttons, no tabs, no numbers, no icons, no background scenery, no shadows outside its silhouette. Transparent outside the board and leaves; parchment interior opaque. Match the soft polished 3D illustrated game aesthetic and exact understated thin wooden frame thickness of the supplied reference. This will have live HTML content placed over it. No watermark. Requested output approximately 1696x1008 PNG.
